title: The Disruptor: A Corporate Entrepreneurship and Innovation Management Simulation
description:
The Disruptor is a free browser simulation for teaching corporate entrepreneurship and innovation management. The player becomes Chief Innovation Officer of Vélox Dynamics, a fictional fitness equipment manufacturer in Vilvoorde, Belgium, with a forty-year heritage, on a three-year brief or a one-year probation that can lead on to the full term. Each year the management board meets on the firm's direction and the CEO sets a goal and three objectives for the CIO. At the end of the first and second years the board questions the CIO on the year.

The game is organised around sixteen connected systems: R&D Portfolio, Innovation Launchpad, Innovation Strategy, Alliances, Standards, Platform, IP Management, Tech Scouting, Universities & Research, Corporate Venturing, Crowdsourcing, Staff & Hiring, Organisation, Competitors & Markets, Grant Funding and Corporate. A Pantheon of Innovation names the scholars whose ideas bear on the player's situation. There are five versions: Forge, Incubator, Pivot, Jugaad and Gauntlet.

Version 2 adds the CIO's decisions on AI in R&D, the board's meetings and appraisals as scenes, and an end-of-game report that sets the board's view of the results beside the game's own assessment of how the player used the tools of corporate entrepreneurship and innovation management.

It runs in a browser from its own folder, with no install and no account.
